_meta.name: English
_meta.note: Every string a person reads in the window. A new language is a new file beside this one, never a change in code - ADR-21. The keys are English too, and they are what the code refers to.

gui.window.title: Better Windows Services
gui.column.name: Name
gui.columns.hint: Choose what the list shows. Drag a heading to move a column and its edge to resize. None of it is kept yet, so closing the window brings the first six back.
gui.search.hint: Search, or write a query: start:auto !status:running
gui.filter.hint: Each of these writes what it stands for into the box, so the filter you clicked is a query you can read and edit.
gui.status.failed: Could not read the service control manager. {0}
gui.status.partial: {0} entries were judged on a field that could not be read, so this list may be missing entries, or holding ones that do not belong.
gui.status.tooCostly: The expression ran out of time on {0} entries, so they were never checked. Try a simpler one.
gui.status.holding: The list is holding still while you use it, so nothing joins or leaves under your cursor. It settles when you move away, or on F5.
gui.status.notElevated: Running without administrator rights, so Windows hands over fewer entries than it has.
gui.start.mark.missing: The file this entry is set to launch is not on disk.
gui.start.mark.disabled: Disabled. It will not start, by itself or on request.
gui.start.mark.unknown: The start type could not be read on this account.
gui.empty.nothingMatched: Nothing on this machine matches what you asked for.
gui.empty.nothingMatchedWayOut: Press Esc to empty the box and see everything again.
gui.empty.nothingToShow: The service control manager handed over no entries at all.
gui.empty.failed: The list could not be read. What went wrong is written under it.
gui.empty.failedWayOut: Press F5 to read the machine again.
gui.query.unreadSignatures: This asks about signatures, which are not read for a listing, so no entry can answer it here. Ask the command line with --signatures.
gui.query.unreadMemory: This asks about memory, which is not read for a listing, so no entry can answer it here. Ask the command line with --memory.
gui.query.unknownField: There is no field called {0}. Fields you can use: {1}.
gui.query.unknownValueNearest: {1} has no value {0}. Did you mean {2}? It accepts: {3}.
gui.query.badPattern: The expression /{0}/ could not be read. {1}
gui.query.unclosedQuote: A quote is opened and never closed, starting at: {0}
gui.query.badNumber: {1} expects a number like 1234, >1000, <500, >=100 or 100-200. It got: {0}
gui.query.emptyTerm: {0} says nothing. A ! needs something after it, and a word needs something in it.
gui.query.patternTooComplex: The wildcard starting {0} has too many parts to build. Use fewer * and ? characters.
gui.query.badSize: {1} expects a size with a unit, like 500MB, >1GB, <100MB or 100MB-1GB. It got: {0}
